sfxProbePrompts.label: Direct Foley instruction
sfxProbePrompts.text: Return audio only. Create one dry 0.8-second gameplay sound effect: a steel pickaxe striking dense underground stone, followed by one compact rock crack and a tiny grit tail. No voice, speech, music, melody, room ambience, or explanation. Begin immediately and end cleanly.

sfxProbePrompts.label: Timed studio cue sheet
sfxProbePrompts.text: Render this studio Foley cue as audio, not a spoken description. 0.00s steel transient; 0.05s dense stone fracture; 0.18s three small grit particles; silence by 0.75s. Dry, close-miked, weighty, game-ready. Absolutely no words, human vocalization, music, or background ambience.

brittle mineral snap; glassy crystal fragments; restrained low resonance
sfxCues.character: valuable, physical, crystalline, not magical music

sfxCues.layers: deep stone strain; one sub-heavy fracture; falling dust granules
sfxCues.character: ominous, geological, readable without being loud

promptStyles.label: Direct Foley
promptStyles.template: Return audio only. Create one {duration} game sound effect for {role}: {layers}. It must feel {character}. No speech, vocalization, music, melody, ambience, or explanation. Start immediately and end cleanly.

promptStyles.label: Layered cue sheet
promptStyles.template: Render a professional game Foley cue as audio, never as spoken narration. Target length: {duration}. Build only these ordered layers: {layers}. Mix character: {character}. Dry mono-compatible center, strong transient, controlled tail. No voice, music, tune, reverb wash, or background bed.

promptStyles.label: Negative-first constraint
promptStyles.template: Do not speak, sing, hum, narrate, or add music. Do not add an ambient bed. Output only a clean {duration} sound-design asset for {role}. Required sonic events: {layers}. Desired identity: {character}. One isolated event with a hard clean ending.
